awdeSegment.prediction: A cycle is completing, making space for an invigorating new phase of renewal and purpose.
awdeSegment.recommendation: Release old patterns that no longer serve you with clarity and gentle boundaries.
awdeSegment.spiritualPractice: Morning prayer accompanied by a tranquil mountain spring or fresh water ritual.
awdeSegment.botanical: Tena Adam (Ruta chalepensis) steeped in warm morning water

telsem.nameEn: Guardian of the Crown & Cognitive Sanctuary
telsem.sacredGeometryDescription: Horizontal panoramic band of nine protective guardian eyes and protective nodes designed to crown the forehead and shield cognitive faculties from nightmares.
telsem.spiritualMeaning: Dedicated to individuals burdened with migraine-like psychic fatigue, intrusive rumination, and troubled dreams. Guards the gate of the mind.
telsem.traditionalFormulaGe: በስመ አብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ፩ አምላክ ጸሎት በእንተ አቃቤ ርዕስ ቂጁን መቂጁን መጁን መጅመጁን... አጥናዮስ ጰፐርኤል... አድህነኒ ወተአቅበኒ እምኩል እርኩሳን አጋንንት ወእኩያነ ሰብእ።
telsem.traditionalFormulaEn: Prayer for the Guardian of the Crown: by these secret holy names, preserve my mind and shield me from every distressing thought and malevolence.
telsem.culturalDisclaimer: Neurological, psychiatric, or physical symptoms must be evaluated by licensed medical doctors.

guardianTelsem.nameGe: ጠልሰመ መስጥመ ቡዳ ወአይነ ጥላ (ሳዶር አላዶር)
guardianTelsem.nameEn: The Sador Alador Evil Eye & Buda Neutralizer
guardianTelsem.sacredGeometryDescription: The sacred cruciform pentagram invoking the 5 wounds of Christ (ሳዶር፣ አላዶር፣ ዳናት፣ አዴራ፣ ሮዳስ) framed by concentric radiating eyes to break the evil eye (ዓይነ ሰብእ).
guardianTelsem.spiritualMeaning: The classical remedy for 'shadow eye' (ዓይነ ጥላ) — feelings of sudden exhaustion, panic when looking into crowds, or persistent dread.
guardianTelsem.traditionalFormulaGe: በስመ አብ ወወልድ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ ፩ አምላክ ጸሎት በእንተ መስጥመ ቡዳ... ሳዶር አላዶር ዳናት አዴራ ሮዳስ አማኑኤል ብርስባሔል... አድህነኒ እምማዕሠረ ሰይጣን።
guardianTelsem.traditionalFormulaEn: In the name of the Trinity, prayer against the ocular affliction... Sador, Alador, Danat, Adera, Rodas, Emmanuel: deliver me from the snares of discord.
guardianTelsem.culturalDisclaimer: Do not inhale dangerous fumes or substitute botanical rituals for licensed medical diagnosis.
